issue.body:
## Describe your changes
`st.tabs` calls `VerticalBlock` to render the contents of each tab - it passes a width that is then overridden by the AutoSizer in `VerticalBlock`, which sets width to 0 for initial mount of non-selected tabs, causing a jitter. More details in the issue.

## GitHub Issue Link (if applicable)
Closes #5820 

## Testing Plan
Don't really have the ability to write automated test for this one - manually tested ✅

### Summary

When a tab has markdown text, it flickers upon first click because the text is weirdly squashed to a small width, and then expands. See video below after I click on "Tab 2". Note that after the tab was clicked on once, that flickering goes away if you click on it again. Not sure if this only happens with markdown or also with other elements. 


https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/5103165/025646b7-af63-42cd-98ba-bc85f1908b43



### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
tab1, tab2, tab3 = st.tabs(["Tab 1", "Tab 2", "Tab 3"])
tab1.write("Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Donec a diam lectus. Sed sit amet ipsum mauris. ")
tab2.write("Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Donec a diam lectus. Sed sit amet ipsum mauris. ")
tab3.write("Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Donec a diam lectus. Sed sit amet ipsum mauris. ")
```
